browser: Headless Microsoft Edge via the existing Puppeteer test infrastructure
isolation: New qa_v14_browser_* PostgreSQL schema; supplied pg Pool has only that schema in search_path; ephemeral loopback HTTP port; synthetic users only.
boundaries: Mail is generated by real registration/recovery/invitation workflows and captured with injected mailer.sendMail; no external SMTP delivery is claimed.
Five desktop Chromium viewport measurements are not physical iPad/Safari/device validation. Physical iPad not verified.
Eight-hour crop maturity uses an injected server clock, not eight hours of wall-clock waiting.
Late-response cases hold actual HTTP response callbacks and deliberately prevent abort from cancelling an already received response; no response body is fabricated.
pageshow coverage dispatches a persisted PageTransitionEvent; real browser BFCache restoration and iPad app suspension are not verified.
No renderer rebuild, production deployment, live family record, real email recipient, or paid service is used.

checks.label: Anonymous real HTML cannot read a family or render synthetic legacy browser data
Registration generates mail; unverified accounts cannot create families; fragment opening is inert and explicit verification succeeds
Creating a family yields one named child, zero points/history and a farm awaiting first use
Owner sets PIN; wrong PIN cannot award points; fresh operation-bound verification commits exactly500
Farm welcome harvest→exchange→place→plant→8h harvest uses real HTTP and leaves the family ledger unchanged
A second family in the same browser starts empty and switching preserves separate child/ledger/farm
Late actual200 from familyA cannot replace lower-revision familyB after a switch
Late actual401 from a revoked old session cannot log out a newly authenticated family
Logout clears the old family/renderer/draft before a held200 callback and foreground ticks run
Owner invitation generates email; another verified email cannot consume it
Target account registers/verifies, explicitly accepts once, and shares the existing child/ledger/farm
Owner member removal blocks retained cookies/old page; revoked email invitation cannot be accepted
Unavailable localStorage/sessionStorage still permits real login, two-family switching and logout
Real same-context cross-tab logout removes old DOM; persisted-pageshow rechecks before restoring anything
Forgot-password mail is generated; explicit reset invalidates old sessions and changes the usable password
